title: Linux from Scratch
summary: Linux from Scratch (LFS) is a project that guides users through building a complete Linux operating system from source code, teaching deep system-level understanding of how Linux works internally.
problem_solved: Teaches deep understanding of Linux internals by having users compile and configure every component from scratch.
why_valuable: Provides unparalleled hands-on learning experience for understanding Linux system architecture, compilation process, and dependencies.
